- 娱乐 (Entertainment): 19%

- 电视栏目 (Television programming) is represented by the blue segment, which accounts for 20% of the pie.
- 广播 (Broadcast) is represented by the orange segment, which has the largest share with 21%.
- 闻名演员 (Famous actors) is represented by the green segment, which is divided into two parts with 6% and an unstated percentage.

There is no legend provided in the chart, but there is a color-coded legend at the bottom with corresponding colors for the categories. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as highlighting or enlarging any of the segments, nor does it provide any information about a sorting function such as sorting in ascending or descending order of the categories.
